lead.headline: Stock Futures Waver Ahead of Midterm Election Results and AMD Earnings
lead.summary: U.S. stock futures were little changed early Tuesday as investors waited for midterm election results. AMD was due to report quarterly earnings after the close.

tech.headline: Tech Sell-Off Extends as AI Return Doubts Weigh on Nasdaq While Dow Gains
tech.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq extended a tech-led sell-off on Monday, even as the Dow gained and oil prices fell. Investors voiced doubts about the returns on AI spending, with memory and optical-communications stocks under pressure.

business.headline: Paramount and California Attorney General Reportedly Set to Discuss Settling Warner Bros. Discovery Lawsuit
business.summary: Paramount and the California attorney general's office reportedly planned to meet Monday to discuss settling the lawsuit over Warner Bros. Discovery. Separately, SpaceX-Tesla merger speculation has drawn attention now that earnings season is winding down.

opinion.headline: Economic Growth Alone Won't Solve the US Debt Problem
opinion.summary: Fox argues that economic growth by itself cannot fix America's fiscal imbalance. The column, from Bloomberg Opinion, looks at the U.S. debt problem.
opinion.author: Justin Fox

opinion.headline: A Terrible Night Awaits the GOP, and Even That Might Be an Understatement
opinion.summary: Olsen offers his final midterm prediction, forecasting that Democrats will win both the House and the Senate. He argues that Republicans face a very bad election night, possibly worse than is widely expected. I read only the headline and subheading, so this summary is limited to that.
opinion.author: Henry Olsen
